GO Pass

GO Pass: October

Tue, Oct 6, 2026, 10:00 AM → Tue, Nov 3, 2026, 10:00 AM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

October's monthly GO Pass (Oct 6 – Nov 3). Rank up by playing to unlock rewards; the top prize is a Kyogre encounter.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Free track highlights

  • A Kyogre encounter (it can be shiny, but that's not guaranteed).
  • Rare Candy XL, a Premium Battle Pass and a Lucky Egg along the way.

Deluxe (paid, US$7.99)

  • Adds a Lucky Trinket: it turns a Great Friend into a Lucky Friend for one trade (use it by Nov 8).
  • Faster progress, a Super Incubator and extra encounters.

Milestone bonuses

  • Rank 1: an extra Candy per trade.
  • Rank 25: bigger Gift limits.
  • Rank 50: Daily Adventure Incense lasts twice as long.
  • Rank 75: better rewards from hatching Eggs.

Tip

Claim your rewards before the pass closes; check the in-game timer for the exact claim deadline.

Written by Trainer Desk from the official announcement, checked October 18, 2026. Details can change, so check in game. See all upcoming GO events or the live event tracker for raid bosses and counters.
